lines.text: Jesus stood among the disciples and said, "Peace be with you," but they were frightened and thought they had seen a spirit.
Jesus told them to touch Him and see, because a spirit does not have flesh and bones.
Jesus asked for something to eat, and they gave Him a piece of roasted lamb, which He ate in front of them.
Jesus said repentance and forgiveness of sins would be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Galilee.
Jesus led them out as far as Bethany, blessed them, and was carried up into heaven.
